Phase 1: Discovery & Strategy (Week 1) We start with a call to understand your business, goals, and how you actually talk. You'll receive strategic questions ahead of time to help you prepare. From there, I build your custom strategy that includes KPIs, marketing audit, competitor analysis, content pillars designed to attract the right clients, and a voice guide that captures your exact words and style.
Phase 2: Pilot (Weeks 2-3) Once your strategy is approved, we create your first batch of content. You'll have your first 30-minute content interview, send us any assets we need, and review everything together. We refine until it sounds exactly like you and you're proud to post it. Then we launch.
Phase 3: Growth (Week 4+) Now you're in a rhythm. A 30-minute interview every two weeks keeps fresh ideas flowing—and gives you the accountability to stay consistent without doing the work yourself. The team and I handle creation, scheduling, engagement, and reporting while you focus on your clients and your business.
Phase 4: Expansion (Beyond Month 6) I refine your strategy based on what's working and where your business is headed. If it makes sense, we explore new platforms or content types like Substack or email marketing—but only when you're ready.
My team and I take content from exhausting to-do list item to completely handled—so you can stop saying "I'll post tomorrow" and start showing up with content you're actually proud of.
Just one hour a month = 4 weeks of strategic content.

I build your strategy, capture your voice, and launch your first content.

WE MAKE YOUR DIGITAL MARKETING OUR FULL TIME JOB
As a white-glove digital marketing agency, our team blends data-driven strategies with the latest trends, all while keeping your goals in the spotlight.
Blah Blah Social is a social media agency based out of downtown Provo, built to take the noise out of showing up online.
We help brands grow through clean content, smart strategy, and real engagement, so your socials actually do something for your business. From content creation to management and community building, we handle the details while you focus on running your brand.
Social Media Management
Social media management is basically having someone run your socials for you—so you stay consistent and look legit without being glued to your phone.
It usually includes planning, creating posts, scheduling, replying to comments/DMs, and capitalizing on what’s trending each month.
Content Creation
Content creation is all about making the photos, videos, and posts your brand needs to show up online.
That includes shooting and designing content, editing it, and creating posts that actually feel on-brand and scroll-stopping—so you always have something good to share.
